skills.name: Forked Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora casts forked lightning in the target direction, dealing 350<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Enemies affected by <font color='#404495'>(Superconductor)</font> will take 190<font color='#27C0C7'>( +30% Total Magic Power)</font> extra <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> after a short delay.
skills.tips: Use Skill 2 first before using skill 1, this will reduce their magic resistance, allowing skill 1 to do more damage.

skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, dealing 350<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>, stunning them for 1.2s, and reducing their Magic Defense by 10 for 1.8s.
If the enemy is affected by <font color='#404495'>(Superconductor)</font>, the lightning orb will bounce to up to 3 nearby enemies (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing 175<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and stunning them for 0.9s.
skills.tips: When being ganked or helping out teammates, you can try using Skill 1 first before skill 2 so the stun lasts longer.

skills.name: Thunder’s Wrath
skills.description:
Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target enemy, dealing 480<font color='#27C0C7'>( +180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>.
If the enemy is affected by <font color='#404495'>(Superconductor)</font>, dark clouds appear over their head and unleash an additional lightning strike on the area after 0.8s, dealing 440<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies within and 360<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies.
skills.tips: Best to use after casting other spells, for maximum damage potential.

skills.name: Superconductor
skills.description: Eudora's skills inflict <font color='#404495'>(Superconductor)</font> for 3s on hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by <font color='#404495'>(Superconductor)</font>.
skills.tips: Skill gives the target a Superconductor effect which will amplify the effects of other abilities.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.des: Unique Passive - Resonate: Every 6s, the next skill that deals damage will resonate, dealing Magic Damage equal to 120% Magic Power against up to 3 enemies and increasing Movement Speed by 30% that decays over 2s.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.

builds.tips: Focus on getting 40% cooldown reduction as the main goal, secondly go for as much magic power as possible to maximize your damage. Then  get Holy Crystal and Devil's Tear to further guarantee your DPS potential,lastly get Concentrated Energy for survivability during team fights.
